keyProp.note: Reconciler identity hint (contract prop of android_js_widget_runtime#2). Not consumed by the flutter reference renderer (node ids are positional), never rendered, never dumped.

offsetX.effect: Transform translate X (logical px; applied together with offsetY), center-aligned

rotate.effect: Rotation in DEGREES (yoclip alias; converted to radians and used when `rotation` is absent)

blur.effect: ImageFiltered gaussian blur, sigma in logical px (sigma <= 0 is skipped)

opacity.effect: Opacity wrap, clamped to [0,1]; skipped when 1.0; ignored on `animatedOpacity` (it animates its own opacity)

ignorePointer.effect: IgnorePointer wrap (overlay labels must not eat gestures)

_alignContentMinMainAxis.note: Internal marker written by the renderer itself (_buildBox) when an explicit `alignment` must center the content: forces MainAxisSize.min. Hosts only need to keep it inert.
